importantNotice: A pointer base inferred from address - Y is a runtime-derived candidate, not an independently observed store to $FD/$FE. Neither value frequency nor pointer relocation proves a musical opcode, loop, or instrument.

$13A7.instruction: source indirect read, inspect code variants

unknowns.question: Which executed instructions populate $FD/$FE immediately before each fetch, and from which pointer table?
requiredProbe: Capture each write to $FD/$FE with PC, frame, X,Y and value
Correlate effective indirect address with source pointer value

unknowns.question: Which fetched bytes determine commands, durations, pitches and instruments?
requiredProbe: For each fetch, capture next executed conditional/dispatch path and mutated state variables
Build a byte/value -> branch/side-effect truth table with negative cases

unknowns.question: Are observed pointer reloads genuine per-voice pattern repeats, jumps or ordinary record changes?
requiredProbe: Capture command position before/after pointer reload, caller/source PC and all state variables
Repeat with at least two subtunes or divergent source paths

unknowns.question: Does the source state (not just SID output) return to an equivalent state with matching subsequent execution?
requiredProbe: Capture canonicalized PLAY-boundary internal state incl. mutable code and per-voice pointers
Compare repeated state and future control traces before certifying a song loop
